why_trail.why: Stage entry points located + signatures captured via Explore sweep: C derive_segment_map+SegmentMapStore.write+SegmentMap.n_segments+split_half_boundary_drift(.median_drift_m)<MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M=10.0; D run_grip_batch+GripStore, heldout helpers private in test_grip_heldout.py; E CLI subprocess writes reference_laps+driver_class_observables, --validate -> jackknife_attribution.json{jackknife.boundary_drift_m.within_anchor, jackknife.positive_control.fired}, logs 'segment map ...: N segments, k=4'; G _derive_vocabulary(severity:%+era_key)+fit_driver_fingerprints(allow_unverified=True); H join_weekend_prior(composition,cells,vocab)->WeekendUtilizationPrior(.mean,.prior.scale), tests t7_1..t7_4; PANEL run_panel(slice_db,f1_db,instruments,report_date) --no-write. join_bounded_validation_667.py is the E->G->H precursor.

Schema (StageSlot/GatingVerdict/CircuitResult/PilotResults, REQUIRED_SLOTS incl distinct grip_g vs fingerprint, REQUIRED_GATES=C/D/E/H, provenance fresh|fell-back), pure helpers (make_scratch_layout isolated under out-dir, subprocess_env utf-8, is_finite_number), verifier script exits non-zero on missing circuit/slot/gate. 8 tests green.
G+H+PANEL wired; critic#3 finite gating (gate_fingerprint/gate_join_prior/gate_observables); 6 tests green on real GB fixture k=4.

C wired (derive_segment_map explicit telemetry_store/grip_bin_db/per_year_db offline + write_segment_map to scratch SegmentMapStore + split_half_boundary_drift gating vs frozen MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M=10; n_segments descriptive). D wired (run_grip_batch restricted to 3 pilot circuits via filtered calendar_fn; held-out score reuses landed #663 harness _reconcile_circuit+_pooled_metrics, grip-worsens=PASS, thin pair=data-coverage PARK). grip_g named distinct. 4 deciders green.

E wired as subprocess (build_e_command all handoff flags; _default_e_runner utf-8+timeout=180+cwd repo_root). Park logic: attempt fresh ONCE then fall back to archived fp_slice_2023Q.db (has all 3 pilot circuits' reference_laps+96 obs) on TimeoutExpired/non-zero/FastF1-fallthrough, stamping provenance=fell-back+reason. E gating reads jackknife_attribution.json{boundary_drift_m.within_anchor, positive_control.fired}. read_observables_meta makes downstream provenance-agnostic (map_version+n_rows from fresh OR fallback). two_map_segment_tripwire flags C-vs-E count divergence WITHOUT unifying. 8 tests green.

run_circuit chains C->D->E->G->H->PANEL per circuit (E result drives provenance + observables_db for downstream; G/H/PANEL provenance-agnostic via read_observables_meta). run_pilot copies tracked f1_data_2023.db to scratch ONCE, runs t7 once, loops circuits. render_report/write_report pure markdown emitter (per-circuit 6 slots + C/D/E/H gating + provenance + flags + t7). scripts/run_pilot_669.py CLI with worktree-first .pth guard, --circuits/--out-dir, writes pilot_results.json + report. 3 tests green.
